project_info.title: Stakeholder Review: Financial-Control and Security Posture

outline.title: Stakeholder Review: Financial-Control and Security Posture
outline.summary: Evidence from the locked PostgreSQL/PostGIS CI environment on August 21, 2026. Code-level controls only; no real funds accessed. Codebase improved but requires remaining environment gates before production approval.

outline.title: Executive Evidence Snapshot
outline.summary: A tabular snapshot of the full CI suite results, whole-code coverage, focused FIN/AUTH coverage, code-only score, and the disabled status of real-value transfers.

outline.title: Test and Coverage Evidence
outline.summary: Visual presentation of the coverage chart showing whole-code baseline, post-fixes coverage, and the 85% critical-path target achievement for FIN/AUTH. Next goals identified.
outline.image_plan: /home/ubuntu/mineralvision-repo/audit_artifacts/security_coverage_evidence.png - Primary visual specified in slide content: security_coverage_evidence.png chart

outline.title: Financial-Transfer Hardening Model
outline.summary: Overview of the ledger hardening: stable idempotency, replay safety, maker-checker separation, HMAC-SHA-256 audit integrity, and internal-only boundaries.

outline.title: FIN-01 through FIN-06 Execution Evidence
outline.summary: A tabular breakdown of the FIN tests and their verified results, including concurrent submission, conflict rejection, MFA approval quorum, and HMAC tampering detection.

outline.title: Identity, MFA, and OPA Security Boundaries
outline.summary: A tabular breakdown of the AUTH tests and their verified results, including OIDC token verification, explicit MFA claims, tenant isolation, and fail-closed OPA enforcement.

outline.title: Defects and Technical Debt Remediated
outline.summary: Summary of the fixes applied in this pass: pending-transfer post/void processing, metadata preservation, malformed password handling, in-memory control conflict semantics, and branch coverage.

outline.title: Remaining Risk and Release Gates
outline.summary: A tabular view of the current posture and required closure evidence for whole-code coverage, oil-spill/WALDO boundaries, real payment operations, environment controls, and CI workflow publication.

outline.title: Recommended Stakeholder Decisions
outline.summary: Four key recommendations: maintain internal-only financial controls, authorize the next test increments, require a protected CI workflow, and fund independent security assessments.

outline.title: Appendices and Evidence Locations
outline.summary: A list of the exact source file and artifact paths for the tests, scripts, runbooks, CI output, and coverage reports used to compile this presentation.
